oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses carriage return, followed by line feed.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

locked.description: Whether the configuration is not allowed to be overridden or extended.

associations.description: Glob patterns of files this plugin should format, in addition to CHANGELOG.md.

sortSections.description: Reorder the ### sections of each release as Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security.

removeEmptySections.description: Remove ### sections that have no content.

requireUnreleased.description: Fail when the changelog has no ## [Unreleased] section.

strictSectionNames.description: Fail on ### sections other than Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed and Security.

requireReferenceLinks.description: Fail when a release heading has no matching [version]: url link reference definition.

additive.description: Run in addition to the plugin that formats Markdown instead of claiming CHANGELOG.md.
